results.content:
# When is Thanksgiving, why it's always on Thursday and other questions answered

Portrait of Nate Trela

Halloween is gone, and the chill in the air across Colorado and the return of winter drink menus across the country are clear signs that Thanksgiving is getting near.

It can be easy to lose track of the date of Thanksgiving, and this year it falls on one of the latest possible points on the calendar. [...] Thanksgiving will be on November 27. The holiday is celebrated on the fourth Thursday of November, meaning Thanksgiving has to fall between Nov. 22 and 28.

## Why is Thanksgiving on the fourth Thursday in November? [...] The suddenness of the change was not well received in parts of the country. Calendars for 1939 and 1940 had already been printed with the last Thursday of November as Thanksgiving, and events like school breaks and sporting events had been scheduled based on that date. For those two years, part of the country celebrated one date, and part celebrated the other.

In 1941, Congress and FDR locked in the fourth Thursday of November as the permanent date for Thanksgiving.

results.title: Why is it called Black Friday? The real history of the name
results.content: Roosevelt's answer was to proclaim Thursday, Nov. 23, as Thanksgiving instead. He announced the change in August 1939, well ahead of the holiday. No law fixed the date at the time. Each year's holiday was set by presidential proclamation. That arrangement gave the president room to make the change on his own authority. [...] The date moves each year with Thanksgiving. Thanksgiving falls on the fourth Thursday of November, and Cyber Monday comes four days later. That places it between Nov. 26 and Dec. 2. When Thanksgiving falls on Nov. 27 or Nov. 28, Cyber Monday lands in December. [...] Thanksgiving sets its place on the calendar. The holiday falls on the fourth Thursday of November, and Giving Tuesday comes five days later. That puts it between Nov. 27 and Dec. 3 each year. The exact date moves with Thanksgiving from one year to the next. It arrives the day after Cyber Monday and closes a sequence that opens with Black Friday and Small Business Saturday.
